rows.label: Corporate tax (Impuesto sobre Sociedades) [national and foral]
rows.value: 25% general; 2026: 19%/21% for companies with turnover under €1,000,000, 23% under €10,000,000; 15% for new companies; 15% minimum top-up tax for groups with turnover of €750,000,000 or more; own rates in the Basque territories and Navarra. Paid by companies resident in Spain and permanent establishments. Ley 27/2014 art. 29 and DT 44ª; Ley 7/2024 (Impuesto Complementario); foral corporate tax laws.

source.title: Ley 27/2014, de 27 de noviembre, del Impuesto sobre Sociedades, artículos 29 y 101 y disposición transitoria cuadragésima cuarta (BOE, texto consolidado, última actualización publicada el 02/09/2026)

rows.label: Branch profits tax (IRNR art. 19.2) [national]
rows.value: 19% on profits a permanent establishment transfers abroad; not for EU-resident companies or treaty countries with reciprocity. Paid by non-resident companies with a permanent establishment in Spain. Real Decreto Legislativo 5/2004 art. 19.

source.title: Real Decreto Legislativo 5/2004, texto refundido de la Ley del Impuesto sobre la Renta de no Residentes, artículo 19 (BOE, texto consolidado, última actualización publicada el 25/05/2023)

rows.label: Self-employed contributions (RETA) [national]
rows.value: 28.3% common and 1.3% professional contingencies plus 0.9% MEI on a base chosen within the band for monthly net income (€653.59 to €5,101.2); reduced quota in the first 12 months. Paid by self-employed people (autónomos). Orden PJC/297/2026 art. 18; Ley 20/2007 art. 38 ter.

source.title: Orden PJC/297/2026, de 30 de marzo, normas de cotización a la Seguridad Social 2026, artículo 18 (Régimen Especial de Trabajadores por Cuenta Propia o Autónomos) (BOE núm. 79, 31 de marzo de 2026)

rows.label: Contractor rules: employee test, TRADE and IRPF withholding on fees [national]
rows.value: employee if working within another's organisation and direction (presumed); 15% withholding on professional fees (7% for new professionals), 1% for listed módulos activities. Paid by businesses paying professionals (withheld from the fee). Estatuto de los Trabajadores arts. 1.1 and 8.1; Ley 20/2007 arts. 1 and 11; Reglamento del IRPF art. 95.

source.title: Real Decreto 439/2007, Reglamento del Impuesto sobre la Renta de las Personas Físicas, artículo 95 (BOE, texto consolidado, última actualización publicada el 07/10/2026)

rows.label: Simplified regimes: objective estimation (módulos), simplified direct estimation and the retailers' equivalence scheme [national]
rows.value: módulos up to €250,000 of income (€150,000 in the Act, being checked); simplified direct estimation up to €600,000 turnover; equivalence surcharge 5.2% for retailers. Paid by sole traders and professionals who use them. Ley 35/2006 arts. 30 and 31; Reglamento del IRPF arts. 28 to 37; Ley 37/1992 arts. 122 and 154 to 163.

source.title: Real Decreto 439/2007, Reglamento del IRPF, artículos 28 y 30; Ley 35/2006 artículo 30.2.4ª (BOE, textos consolidados)

rows.label: Non-resident tax on employment income (IRNR) [national]
rows.value: 24% on gross pay for work in Spain (19% for EU and EEA residents, 2% for seasonal workers); resident after more than 183 days. Paid by non-resident employees (withheld by the payer). Real Decreto Legislativo 5/2004 arts. 13, 24, 25 and 31; Ley 35/2006 art. 9.

source.title: Real Decreto Legislativo 5/2004, texto refundido de la Ley del Impuesto sobre la Renta de no Residentes, artículos 13, 24, 25 y 31 (BOE, texto consolidado, última actualización publicada el 25/05/2023)

rows.label: Property tax (IBI) [municipal]
rows.value: 0.4% to 1.1% of cadastral value for urban property, 0.3% to 0.9% for rural property, set by each council. Paid by owners and holders of rights over real estate. Real Decreto Legislativo 2/2004 arts. 60 to 77.

source.title: Real Decreto Legislativo 2/2004, texto refundido de la Ley Reguladora de las Haciendas Locales, artículos 60 a 77 (Impuesto sobre Bienes Inmuebles) (BOE, texto consolidado, última actualización publicada el 07/10/2026)

rows.label: Property transfer tax (ITP) and stamp duty on deeds (AJD) [regional (state rates in Ceuta and Melilla)]
rows.value: 6% state rate on real estate, regional rates from 6% to 13%; AJD 0.5% state rate; new homes pay 10% VAT instead. Paid by the buyer. Real Decreto Legislativo 1/1993; each community's tax law; foral laws.

source.title: Real Decreto Legislativo 1/1993, texto refundido de la Ley del Impuesto sobre Transmisiones Patrimoniales y Actos Jurídicos Documentados, artículos 8, 11, 31 y 57 bis (BOE, texto consolidado, última actualización publicada el 21/03/2026)

rows.label: Regional income tax (IRPF autonómico) [regional]
rows.value: each common-regime community sets the regional half of the general scale (and may set its own minimums and credits); the Basque territories and Navarra set the whole foral scale. Paid by resident individuals. Ley 35/2006 art. 74; Ley 22/2009 art. 46.

rows.value: no church tax; taxpayers may allocate 0.7% of their income tax due to the Catholic Church at no extra cost. Paid by the State, out of the income tax of taxpayers who choose it. Ley 42/2006 additional provision 18.

rows.value: 19% for residents; non-residents 19% on dividends, interest and gains, 24% on other income (19% EU/EEA). Paid by payers of investment income (withheld). Reglamento del IRPF arts. 90 and 101; Real Decreto Legislativo 5/2004 art. 25.

rows.label: Rental income and pension income taxation [national]
rows.value: net rent on the general scale with a 50% to 100% reduction for homes let as a permanent residence; pensions taxed as work income; non-residents' pensions 8%, 30% and 40%. Paid by landlords and pensioners. Ley 35/2006 arts. 17.2 and 23.2; Real Decreto Legislativo 5/2004 art. 25.1.b.

rows.value: 0.2% on acquisitions of shares in Spanish listed companies worth over €1,000m. Paid by buyers of the shares (charged by the financial intermediary). Ley 5/2020.

rows.value: 5.11269632% of the electricity bill (minimum €0.5 or €1 per MWh); 7% tax on the value of electricity generation in 2026. Paid by electricity consumers; generators (IVPEE). Ley 38/1992 art. 99; Ley 15/2012 art. 8.

rows.value: state scale 0.2% to 3.5% above a €700,000 exempt amount (main home exempt up to €300,000); each community may set its own scale and reliefs. Paid by resident individuals with net wealth above the exempt amount; non-residents on Spanish assets. Ley 19/1991.

rows.value: state scale 7.65% to 34% times a multiplier of 1 to 2.4 by kinship and pre-existing wealth; communities set their own reductions, rebates and scales. Paid by heirs and donees. Ley 29/1987 arts. 20 to 22.

rows.value: 0%, 4.75%, 9.75% or 14.75% of the price by CO2 emissions (communities may raise them; Canary Islands one point lower; Ceuta and Melilla 0%). Paid by buyers registering a new or imported vehicle. Ley 38/1992 art. 70.

rows.value: cars from €12.62 to €112 a year by fiscal horsepower, times a council coefficient of up to 2. Paid by vehicle owners. Real Decreto Legislativo 2/2004 arts. 92 to 99.
